metadata.description: Claude Code mods and plugins. Includes usage-status, which shows usage gauges.

plugins.name: usage-status
plugins.description: Always shows the 5-hour and 1-week usage limits and the session token usage as gauges below the mode line. A gauge turns red at 80%.

plugins.name: compact-assist
plugins.description: Shows a compact cue below the mode line when context usage reaches 70%. /compact-memo writes a memo.

plugins.name: notify-on-wait
plugins.description: Plays a 0.3-second sound and blinks a band and a pane until answered when a permission prompt or a model question appears.

plugins.name: session-rm
plugins.description: Lists the sessions of this project in a pane. Deletes the one you pick, with its related data.
